items.note: Re-judged after the stylesheet change, which only adds table padding on phones, the hidden .sr labels and the makers' section; this page has none of them and looks as judged.

items.title: QR layouts A and B, with phone scan reports (Phase 4, after the sheets)
Phase 8: final renders, the joined film, chapter markers, YouTube text, thumbnail
Phase 9: a phone scan of every code off a real screen; the typo pass on every lettered word
Line p014.1: speech-to-text missed "minds"
items.note: Whisper (small.en, no hints) hears 'remembered by the memory minds back on Earth': every word right. ElevenLabs' speech-to-text heard 'mines'; the voice says 'minds'.

items.title: Line p052.1: speech-to-text missed "roal"
items.note: Does F-1 say 'Roal' right in 'Roal--your thoughts' (p052.1, assets/voice/p052.1-t1-4553aff14c.mp3)? Two transcribers hear something extra: ElevenLabs 'Roald', Whisper 'Rohan' (and 'Roal' only when told the name). The narrator's 'Roal' is heard as one syllable, 'Rol', as Round 1 chose. The voice pass kept this as its best take. My recommendation: listen; if it sounds like 'Roald', voice this one line again (a few credits).

items.title: The side-view figure draws every person in Roal's ankle robe
items.note: DES.personSide now gives everyone but Roal a tunic to mid-thigh over two legs, the far one a little back when standing, as the front view and model sheets have. Checked side-on in ch00 (the memory) and ch08 (Trest talking): tunic, belt, legs and boots read; Roal keeps his robe.

items.title: Each full re-render adds about 220 MB of draft video to the repository
items.note: Curt chose GitHub Release files. Chapter drafts now go to the repo's drafts release (publish_review.mjs uploads them under content-hashed names), and the pages play them from there with a source element typed video/mp4, which Safari needs because GitHub serves release files as octet-stream. Checked in Chromium and Safari: a draft page, and the annotated film jumping to chapter 7. The old videos stay in git history (about 530 MB); removing them would mean rewriting history and a force push.

items.title: The scorecard page spoke to the makers, though visitors are sent to it
items.note: It now opens with a plain summary for visitors (how far the film and site have come, what's next, what each column means), with Curt's questions, the checks and every judgment in a collapsed 'For the makers' section; the duplicates under Other items are gone.

items.title: The scorecard said '0 changed since passing' beside a stale check
items.note: The checks now have their own count ('n of m pass') in the makers' section, apart from the items' summary.

items.title: The scorecard's marks explained themselves only in hover tooltips
items.note: Each mark now carries its state in words for screen readers (visually hidden), and every judgment's reason is listed in the makers' section, readable by touch.

items.title: The film's scrubber moved 0.1 s per key press and read out raw seconds
items.note: Its step is now 5 s and it reads out e.g. '15:00 of 57:03' (aria-valuetext), checked in the browser.

items.title: The film page showed two clocks, the chapter's and the whole film's
items.note: The bar's line now says 'of the whole film, 57:03 (the player's own clock counts the chapter)'.

items.title: The film page lacked the site's masthead and framed itself as a review exhibit
items.note: It now has the site's masthead, nav and footer; the kicker reads 'Watch: the film in draft, with notes'; the title sits in the text column.

items.title: The fact-check list's intro and sources were written for the makers
items.note: The intro says plainly who checked what and when; 'read in Phase 0' is 'read'; sources show their titles (e.g. 'Amazing Stories (Wikipedia)') instead of keys.

items.title: The home page opened with the 1961 reprint's header as if it were the site's
items.note: The home kicker is now 'From Amazing Stories, August 1932'; the Read page keeps the 1961 masthead, which is part of the text it prints.

items.title: Nits: an unnamed 'us', 'a dozen' for thirteen, Morey's disputed birth year, a degree with no scale
items.note: The Review page names Curt Cox and Claude; About, history and afterword say thirteen smaller slips (16 restorations less the clause and two negatives); Morey's birth year notes that some sources give 1899; the 3,600 degrees says its source gives no scale.

items.title: Chapter 5: the dead guinea pig turns through the cage floor
items.note: DES.cage flattens the pig onto its side when it dies; checked at 499 and 503 s (out/check/ch05_pig.jpg): it lies inside the cage.

items.title: The Outsiders are drawn in see-through wash
items.note: Each plate on an opaque brown fill; checked in ch02 at 125 and 290 s and ch06 at 115 and 125 s, and on sheet 4: solid figures that stay separate where they overlap.

items.title: Chapter 5: Roal's turn to go squashes him to a sliver for two frames
items.note: New draft, 6:28-6:30 at 6 fps: Roal narrows to about 60% at the turn's middle and reads as a man turning, never a sliver.

items.title: Chapter 1: two worker machines fly stacked for 12 s, like one drawn twice
items.note: New draft, 0:55-1:11 every 2 s: workers cross now and then but part within a few seconds; no pair flies stacked.

items.title: Chapter 2: the Outsiders searching ship 2 walk through each other
items.note: New draft, 4:03-4:51 every 6 s: the three searchers stand apart at their own spots, shoulder to shoulder at closest, and the projector Outsider has its own space; none walks through another.

items.title: Chapter 3: a machine stands at Trest's back through Roal's speech; Jupiter and Saturn overlap
items.note: New draft, 6:12-7:08: the nearest ring machine stands beside Trest, clear of his back; 7:08-7:24: the worlds sit apart, Jupiter clear of Saturn.

items.title: Chapter 6: the Outsiders feeding the generators stand in overlapped pairs
items.note: New draft, 1:52-2:08: the four feeders stand as two clear pairs flanking the generator, a gap between each.

items.title: Chapter 7: the dome starts as a stray triangle
items.note: New draft, 2:41-2:49 every second: the canopy rises from a line along the floor as a whole low dome to the full arch; no stray triangle.

items.title: The Outsiders' ships are see-through: a ship behind shows through one in front
items.note: New draft, ch10 2:14-2:22: the flagship's hull hides the ships behind it; no ribs or bands show through.

items.title: Chapter 1: the close loses its pair, and the leap lands as a blot
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: the leap (3:00-3:25) lands in a soft pale haze where the arc ends, no hard blot; at the close (3:32-3:42) the man and the machine walk side by side from 900 toward 2300 through clear ground, the strollers and the crate man clear of them.

items.title: Chapter 2: a crawler walks into the close Outsider's arm
items.note: On the re-rendered draft, 1:40-2:05 (G): the three crawlers sway within 620-1110 and stand apart from the close Outsider at 1400 in every frame; nothing stands in its arm.

items.title: Chapter 3: Roal's thought is invisible, and the wreck scene stages things into each other
items.note: On the re-rendered draft: Roal's curl (0:58-1:05) reads as a darker ribbon rising off his head against the hall; shot P (4:10-5:37) keeps all three downed ships through the shot, the standing machines draw in front of the hulls, and the transports land on the far ground behind them.

items.title: Chapter 6: the motes' turned death ray barely shows
items.note: On the re-rendered draft, 3:07-3:31 (I): each mote's turned ray is a pale green beam ending in a green burst on the giant's hull, plain against the red screens; the chapter's turn reads.

items.title: Chapter 7: inside the dome the two faces are dark
items.note: On the re-rendered draft, 2:55-3:04 (K): under the five lit screens both men's faces are redrawn above the shade and glow pale, the two faces in their light; the bodies stay dark.

items.title: Chapter 9: Roal pops out and back in at the dome
items.note: Fresh eyes, 3:21-3:28: Roal's stander waits at its start (x 100) from tK, visible before 'Roal and Trest appeared', vanishes at ~205 s and walks back in from the edge; the dome they leave isn't seen and they cross the rock, not past it. Major.

items.title: Chapter 4: the new machine reads as MX-3401
items.note: Fresh eyes, 3:50-5:16: builder i=3 carries the MX-3401 label (ch04.js:83); it stands behind the new machine, so the label prints across F-1's hull at its birth. Major.

items.title: Chapters 7 and 8: Roal and Trest stand still through F-2's speeches
items.note: Fresh eyes: ch08 2:43-3:37 (F-2's 54 s 'Last of Men' speech) and ch07 1:37-2:01: the two men are stock-still in profile (frame difference ~2 grey levels, the boil); 'Roal turned' (ch07 89.7 s) has no turn. Fails acting at the emotional peak. Major.

items.title: The film page's notes describe things the film doesn't show
items.note: Fresh eyes: the 0:00 note says the line over the title is 'A Classic Reprint' (1961), but the title page reads 'AMAZING STORIES · August, 1932'; the 5:10 and 5:39 notes speak of the story's footnotes on screen, but chapter 2 draws none. Major.

items.title: Chapter 9: the ruby flame doesn't read
items.note: Fresh eyes, 4:07-4:30: no red at 253-257 s, the sphere a flat yellow blob, the violet halo a faint pink rim; at 262 s the sphere is cut by the frame top; 3:30-3:56 a near-static sphere for 26 s. Minor.

items.title: Sound: the mix drops to digital silence for ~2 s at holds
items.note: Fresh eyes: about a dozen ~2 s spans of true silence (peak -inf), e.g. ch02 3:33, ch05 5:00, ch05 2:00/2:28/5:55/8:19, ch06 4:11, ch07 1:28, ch09 2:53, ch11 1:07/1:34; room tone and music stop dead and can sound like a dropout. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 3: the last Outsiders fall before the line, and fifty read as three
items.note: Fresh eyes, 4:46-5:06: all ships down by ~4:50, 'The last of the Outsiders was down' at 4:58 then a static ~15 s; three ships for 'the remaining fifty'; two or three capsules for 'scores of great transports'. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 4: the ray seems to come from Roal
items.note: Fresh eyes, 0:21-0:38: the ray-machine hovers touching Roal's head and its pink beam starts behind his shoulder. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 1: the population curve's peak leaves the frame
items.note: Fresh eyes, 1:49-1:58: as the camera eases in the curve's peak is cut by the frame top and the rest is empty dark. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 2: the close Outsider reads as a giant
items.note: Fresh eyes, 1:28-2:08: drawn twice the size on the same floor line, so he reads as bigger, not nearer. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 7: the dome leaves the hall between shots; F-2 hidden and recoloured
items.note: Fresh eyes: 2:45-2:52 the dome is inside the hall, from 3:05 on open ground under black sky; at 2:02 an arriving machine passes over F-2; F-2 pale silver in ch07, dark slate in ch08. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 10: 'turned inside out, curves were lines' is undersold
items.note: Fresh eyes, 1:28-2:32: a tilt and a bend for ~6 s, then a near-static 64 s shot. Minor.

items.title: Site: stale status wording and the Read masthead's date
items.note: Fresh eyes: home says acting 'chapter by chapter, starting with chapter 5' and the film banner 'the acting is being redone chapter by chapter', now done; the Read masthead pairs 'A Classic Reprint' (1961) with 'August, 1932'; 'Curt Cox … What stayed with them' reads oddly. Minor.

items.title: Chapter 11: the last push cuts the running head
items.note: Fresh eyes, 2:20 on: the camera push takes the running head off the top and leaves its rule orphaned. Nit.

items.title: Chapter 8: low contrast inside the dome
items.note: Fresh eyes: the figures are dark grey on dark brown (mean luma ~72); they read, but faint on a phone. Nit.

fresh.note: Site only (the drafts were mid-render): a subagent with no context reviewed every page and its screenshots against the rubric. 1 major (the scorecard page spoke to makers), 7 minor, 5 nits; all fixed and recorded as find.* items. A film round follows when the drafts are done.
